initial_decision.brief_rationale: Both observed promotion risks equal 0.8, giving a descriptive difference of zero. R135-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. Thus the average causal risk difference is not uniquely determined; passing arithmetic checks does not establish causal identification.
